author: reek
body: Multiple poker variants using the Poker chapter's hand evaluation. Each variant has its own deal logic, simplified betting (check/bet/fold modeled as check-only with showdown), and showdown resolution.

author: reek
body: Card encoding: 0-51, rank = card mod 13 (0=2..12=Ace), suit = card/13. Suits: 0=clubs, 1=diamonds, 2=hearts, 3=spades.

author: reek
body: Wild cards: when evaluating, replace wilds with the best possible rank/suit. Simplified: count wilds, add them to best rank count.
